sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The mythical Greek inventor Daedalus named his son, Icarus, after this flying [[Titan]]. Daedalus created artificial wings out of feathers and wax, which he and his son used to escape from the evil King Minos. {{source|Huntik.com}}

A large number of Icarus Titans are under the control of the Casterwill family, and had been assimilated by Legion. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}} Icarus Titans were also some of the favored defenders of the [[Fortress of Iron Will]], a Casterwill meeting place. {{source|The Spiral War}}

sections.heading: Sophie's Icarus
sections.wikitext:
[[Sophie Casterwill]] invoked her Icarus in [[Basilisk House]] to fight against [[the Organization]] but he was defeated by [[DeFoe]]'s [[Kreutalk]]. {{source|Absent Heroes}} In [[Thessalonica, Greece]], in the operation to recover the sunken shipwreck, [[Icarus]] threaded the rope through the eye of [[Caliban]]'s dagger. Later, Sophe invoked him to fight the Organization forces but he was defeated by two Suits' [[Raypulse]] blasts. {{source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

Sophie later invoked Icarus to escape from a group of [[Casterwill Hunters]] who she was leading into an ambush. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}}

sections.heading: Other Icarus
sections.wikitext:
[[DeFoe|DeFoe]] possessed the amulet of an Icarus, though he never used it against the Huntik team. {{Source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

At some point in time, the Icarus of an unknown [[Seeker]] had been absorbed by [[Legion]], the [[Legendary Titan]] of War. Legion used Icarus' Blinding Bolts ability against the Huntik team in [[Egypt]]. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}} At the [[Spiral Mark]], Legion used the ability once again against [[Lok]] and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]]. When Lok shattered Legion's Amulet and Legion was destroyed, Icarus and the thousands of other absorbed Titans returned to [[Spirit World|Huntik]], the spirit world. {{Source|The Spiral Mark}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Icarus is able to fire lightning bolts from his wings, and can generate blue energy spheres as well. He can shoot laser rays from his eyes. His wings allow him flight and he is one of the fastest flying titans. Icarus is able to hold the weight of a human to temporarily allow them flight, even while being silent, making him a deadly foe. {{source|Memory Lane}} Icarus's stats are low, but he is a sharpshooter and has fantastic abilities at long range. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}} His considerable accuracy means he can thread a needle with ease. {{source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

full_text:
Icarus are humanoid Krono-Titans who possess bird-like wings instead of arms. Icarus Titans are commonly used by Casterwill family members alongside Feyone, and one appears in the arsenal of Sophie Casterwill.

History

The mythical Greek inventor Daedalus named his son, Icarus, after this flying Titan. Daedalus created artificial wings out of feathers and wax, which he and his son used to escape from the evil King Minos. [Huntik.com]

A large number of Icarus Titans are under the control of the Casterwill family, and had been assimilated by Legion. [Rassimov's Secret] Icarus Titans were also some of the favored defenders of the Fortress of Iron Will, a Casterwill meeting place. [The Spiral War]

Sophie's Icarus

Sophie Casterwill invoked her Icarus in Basilisk House to fight against the Organization but he was defeated by DeFoe's Kreutalk. [Absent Heroes] In Thessalonica, Greece, in the operation to recover the sunken shipwreck, Icarus threaded the rope through the eye of Caliban's dagger. Later, Sophe invoked him to fight the Organization forces but he was defeated by two Suits' Raypulse blasts. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Sophie later invoked Icarus to escape from a group of Casterwill Hunters who she was leading into an ambush. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Mallory's Icarus

Mallory used his Icarus alongside White's Feyone to attack the Huntik team as they tried to land on the shores of the Crystal Caves. He was defeated by boulder thrown by Dante Vale's Metagolem. [Cave of the Casterwills]

Other Icarus

DeFoe possessed the amulet of an Icarus, though he never used it against the Huntik team. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

At some point in time, the Icarus of an unknown Seeker had been absorbed by Legion, the Legendary Titan of War. Legion used Icarus' Blinding Bolts ability against the Huntik team in Egypt. [Rassimov's Secret] At the Spiral Mark, Legion used the ability once again against Lok and Sophie. When Lok shattered Legion's Amulet and Legion was destroyed, Icarus and the thousands of other absorbed Titans returned to Huntik, the spirit world. [The Spiral Mark]

Abilities

Icarus is able to fire lightning bolts from his wings, and can generate blue energy spheres as well. He can shoot laser rays from his eyes. His wings allow him flight and he is one of the fastest flying titans. Icarus is able to hold the weight of a human to temporarily allow them flight, even while being silent, making him a deadly foe. [Memory Lane] Icarus's stats are low, but he is a sharpshooter and has fantastic abilities at long range. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] His considerable accuracy means he can thread a needle with ease. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Trivia

• Icarus' summoning commands are "Take flight," "Air support," "Fly," and "Fly Swiftly."
• Icarus is based on Icarus, the young man who flew too close to the sun with wax wings in Greek mythology.
• At the end of "The Treasures of the Argonauts," an Icarus Amulet can be seen among DeFoe's amulets that Dante Vale used the Sorrowbond spell on.
